landmarks.name: Orthanc
landmarks.info: Nearly eight hundred feet of black rock in the middle of the Ring: four many-sided piers welded into one, opening near the top into horns as sharp as spear-points, with a floor of polished stone between them. A stair of twenty-seven steps goes up to its one door, and above the door is the window and balcony Saruman speaks from.

landmarks.name: The Ring of Isengard
landmarks.info: A ring-wall of black rock like towering cliffs, a mile across inside, standing out from the foot of Methedras. One way in: a long tunnel under an arch in the south wall, with doors of iron at either end. Its inner face is cut with chambers and halls, so that the whole circle is overlooked by windows and dark doors.

landmarks.name: The Gate of Isengard
landmarks.info: The only way in: an arch in the southern wall, and a long tunnel through the black rock closed at either end with doors of iron. The Isen goes out beside it.

landmarks.name: Methedras
landmarks.info: The last peak of the Misty Mountains, standing over the Ring to the north. The Isen rises on it.

landmarks.name: Fangorn
landmarks.info: The old forest on the hills to the east, its eaves ragged where Saruman's orcs have been felling it for his furnaces. The Ents live in it.

landmarks.name: Saruman's dam
landmarks.info: Across the glen of the Isen above the Ring, a wall of stone holds back the river in a reservoir, and sluices in its face let it down to the wheels and the furnaces. The Ents break it.

hosts._: the Uruk-hai marching the Isen Road south to the Fords and to Helm's Deep
